title: 2022 Score #7 Earl Campbell Houston Oilers Football Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: This 2022 Score Football Base card features Earl Campbell, a legendary player for the Houston Oilers. The card is part of the modern era set and has the card number #7. It is a single card from the base set, manufactured by Panini. The card is standard size and is perfect for any NFL fan or collector. The card is not autographed and features no additional details. Get your hands on this Earl Campbell card and add it to your collection today!
